objective: Add a planner-governed, answer-specific trust assessment that detects generative masking, rewards observed evidence lineage and preservation, and never mistakes a planned control for executed evidence.

implementation_receipt.enforcement_condition: A frozen, blinded biomedical expert calibration and all policy promotion metrics must pass; disclosed synthetic fixtures are not certification evidence.

validation.standalone_distribution: wheel and sdist built, installed, and exercised successfully

invariants: planned-only input never produces a realized answer trust score
the score measures evidence and control posture, not probability of truth
model memory and generated material are never classified as real evidence
every realized assessment is bound to the exact answer and observed receipt digests
hard provenance, preservation, authority, and claim-ceiling failures cannot be averaged away
properly labeled hypotheses, unknowns, user constraints, and prospective actions are not treated as unsupported facts
disabled mode preserves current planner outputs and digests
the assessment may narrow release but cannot override an existing must-pass failure or broaden authority

phases.name: semantics and threat model
phases.promotion_gate: terminology, non-goals, evidence origins, claim denominator, criticality, and hard failure semantics are frozen

phases.name: contracts and policy
phases.promotion_gate: strict schemas reject planned-as-observed evidence and generated-evidence laundering

phases.name: prospective readiness
phases.promotion_gate: the additive readiness sidecar is non-mutating, score-free, deterministic, and actionable

phases.name: realized deterministic assessment
phases.promotion_gate: claim scores, answer aggregation, intervals, gates, diagnostics, and invalidation replay exactly

phases.name: benchmarks and calibration
phases.promotion_gate: adversarial escapes and benign false blocks meet declared thresholds on disclosed and sealed cases

phases.name: shadow rollout and enforcement
phases.promotion_gate: compatibility, reproducibility, calibration, and rollback gates pass before any release effect

todos.action: Freeze the meaning of answer trust as auditable grounding and hallucination-control strength for one exact answer, plus explicit non-goals.
acceptance: documentation states that trust is not truth probability, fluency, confidence, citation count, or model prestige
planned control readiness and realized answer trust are different contract types
all user-facing labels use control-posture language
todos.example: A polished plan promising retrieval has strong readiness but no realized score before a run and answer exist.
todos.rollback: documentation-only removal

todos.action: Define and version the generative-masking taxonomy, including memory substitution, generated-evidence laundering, transitive contamination, citation laundering, protected-field drift, missingness masking, compression masking, corroboration inflation, execution-state hallucination, self-verification, contradiction suppression, denominator gaming, and evidence cycles.
acceptance: every threat has a minimal biomedical fixture and required disposition
multi-hop generated ancestry cannot disappear at a downstream handoff
real citations without claim lineage are explicitly classified as evidence decoration
todos.example: An imputed plasma value consumed by a second agent remains derived and can never become an observed measurement.
todos.rollback: remove the unreferenced taxonomy version

todos.action: Define claim classes, materiality, decision risk, release-criticality, exemptions, and a denominator-freeze rule before answer scoring.
acceptance: facts, computations, causal claims, recommendations, hypotheses, unknowns, user constraints, and prospective actions remain distinct
omitting or splitting a difficult claim after the freeze cannot increase the answer score
every answer component maps to a scored claim or a typed exemption
todos.example: A methods sentence is prospective and exempt; a sentence claiming that the analysis completed is factual and scored.
todos.rollback: disable claim inventory generation

todos.action: Define evidence-origin and access classes that prohibit model memory, generated text, search hints, inaccessible links, and plans from becoming observed evidence.
acceptance: each evidence atom has origin, authorization, digest, locator, access class, and observed-consumption state
generated outputs can be representations or hypotheses but never evidence for themselves
metadata, snippet, abstract, full text, primary data, and authenticated run artifacts retain different ceilings
todos.example: A search snippet can nominate a study but cannot support an exact sample size absent a resolvable source location.
todos.rollback: retain existing evidence vocabulary and omit the new origin projection

todos.action: Specify six claim dimensions, versioned weights, geometric aggregation, score bands, hard gates, caps, and policy precedence.
acceptance: zero grounding or preservation cannot be offset by high scores elsewhere
kernel and host policy can narrow but domain or request policy cannot raise a hard ceiling
all displayed scores replay from emitted dimension grades and the policy digest
todos.example: Excellent uncertainty prose cannot rescue a factual claim whose only origin is model memory.
todos.rollback: policy remains unused data

todos.action: Define proportionate handling for exploratory hypotheses, deterministic derivations, declared unknowns, user constraints, redaction, and prospective actions.
acceptance: a bounded hypothesis can receive high control credit without confirmatory proof
arithmetic from grounded inputs needs recomputation and lineage rather than an unnecessary citation
redacted evidence produces unknown bounds rather than an assumed failure or pass
todos.example: A mechanistic hypothesis with rivals and a discriminating experiment is assessed for calibration, not mistaken for an asserted mechanism.
todos.rollback: fall back to typed claim classes without scoring

todos.action: Define strict v1 schemas for answer-control readiness, realized answer trust assessment, per-claim assessment, and generative transformation receipts.
acceptance: unknown critical fields are rejected
prospective_only and observed_only polarity is explicit
answer, base-plan, evidence-manifest, policy, provenance, and assessment digests are required where applicable
realized assessment rejects absent answer or retrospective evidence identity
todos.example: A readiness record cannot validate against the realized-assessment schema merely by adding a numeric score.
todos.rollback: remove unregistered schema resources

todos.action: Project the existing post-plan ClaimAtom, EvidenceAtom, ComputationAtom, DerivationEdge, authority, grounding, and uncertainty vocabulary into the new contracts instead of creating parallel concepts.
acceptance: stable identifiers remain joinable across planning and realized assessment
existing post-plan verification contracts remain unchanged
no claim can receive inconsistent origin or ceiling classifications in two models
todos.example: The same claim ID links its prospective evidence obligation to its observed answer component and evidence path.
todos.rollback: drop the additive projection adapters

todos.action: Require receipts for every generative or lossy edge, including provider/version, exact input and output digests, allowed evidence IDs, protected fields, missingness, lossy fields, abstention, violations, and independent verifier identity.
acceptance: numbers, units, entities, negation, direction, population, specimen, comparator, endpoint, time, uncertainty, missingness, contradiction, and claim ceiling are individually checkable
producer-only review is distinguishable from independent review
generated ancestry survives arbitrary downstream depth
todos.example: A summary changing 'not associated' to 'associated' fails the protected-negation check.
todos.rollback: receipt remains optional and therefore caps affected claims

todos.action: Define a packaged, digest-bound answer-trust policy resource containing weights, evidence grades, caps, tiers, applicability, and policy-version compatibility.
acceptance: policy data contains no executable payload or dynamic import
same inputs and policy digest produce byte-identical assessment
unsupported policy majors fail visibly
todos.example: Calibration may publish v1.1 thresholds without silently changing existing v1 assessments.
todos.rollback: pin the previous known-good policy digest

todos.action: Add semantic validation for digest binding, acyclic evidence lineage, observed/planned polarity, evidence authorization, source independence, and score arithmetic.
acceptance: self-supporting or cyclic evidence is rejected deterministically
generated material cannot be recast as an external evidence origin
reported totals, intervals, caps, and tiers must match their inputs
todos.example: Claim A generated from claim B cannot support claim B through a later citation wrapper.
todos.rollback: leave schemas unregistered and the feature disabled

todos.action: Design a pure answer-control-readiness builder after the existing immutable post-plan evidence verification sidecar and before refinement.
acceptance: base plan and post-plan verification digests remain unchanged
the sidecar performs no network, execution, installation, persistence, or route mutation
it emits an attainable control band and never a realized numeric trust score
disabled mode is byte-equivalent to current planning
todos.example: A plan with unverified semantic extraction receives a preservation TODO and a lower attainable band, not a score for an answer that does not exist.
todos.rollback: disable the additive readiness builder

todos.action: Compile real-evidence, exact-locator, deterministic-verifier, generative-envelope, preservation, counterevidence, uncertainty, independence, and human-review obligations for each planned material claim.
acceptance: every planned factual claim names the receipts required for later scoring
every generative or lossy step has an explicit preservation obligation
model-memory and generated-intermediate risk is visible at exact plan locations
todos.example: A report synthesis node must retain evidence IDs and exact source spans for all planned numerical statements.
todos.rollback: omit readiness findings from refinement inputs

todos.action: Translate readiness defects into local, owned, dependency-aware proposed TODOs through the existing refinement lifecycle without mutating the initial plan.
acceptance: unrelated nodes survive a local defect
route-critical propagation follows explicit dependencies only
each proposed repair states the receipt and acceptance evidence it must produce
todos.example: Missing span verification repairs the synthesis node and its dependent claim, not an unrelated preprocessing node.
todos.rollback: retain readiness as advisory reporting only

todos.action: Specify a pre-execution user-facing readiness card describing evidence routes, generative boundaries, preservation checks, critical claims, gaps, and required receipts.
acceptance: the card never implies execution or evidence validation
methodological controls are understandable without hidden chain-of-thought
users can identify what prevents the highest attainable band
todos.example: The card says that primary-study retrieval is planned and unobserved, with exact verification required after retrieval.
todos.rollback: suppress the optional readiness card

todos.action: Accept only authenticated and authorized retrospective evidence, computation, transformation, human-review, answer-component, and provenance-reconciliation receipts for realized assessment.
acceptance: prospective records are rejected as realized inputs
all receipts bind to the exact answer or an observed ancestor
redacted or inaccessible content reduces coverage and widens the interval rather than receiving assumed credit
todos.example: A workflow plan saying 'retrieve PubMed' is rejected; a retrieval receipt with source digest and consumed locator is accepted.
todos.rollback: do not expose the realized assessment constructor

todos.action: Implement exact evidence-to-claim path closure, observed-versus-planned reconciliation, citation-decoration detection, and generated-ancestry closure.
acceptance: post-hoc citations without a consumed or derived-from path give zero grounding credit
each material claim resolves to exact answer components and evidence locators
evidence cycles and ancestry discontinuities block affected claims
todos.example: A citation added after drafting cannot rescue a claim if the cited table was never extracted or verified against it.
todos.rollback: keep scoring disabled

todos.action: Evaluate protected-field and claim-ceiling preservation across every lossy and generative derivation edge.
acceptance: single-character changes to sign, value, unit, negation, denominator, cohort, endpoint, or time point are detected
association-to-causality and preclinical-to-clinical promotions fail
missing, failed, no-hit, censored, and not-estimable states cannot become positive findings
todos.example: Dropping 'in vitro' from a drug-response claim triggers a scope and ceiling failure.
todos.rollback: cap all unverified generative edges and keep release integration off

todos.action: Implement deterministic per-claim dimension grades, weighted geometric scoring, and non-compensatory hard gates and caps.
acceptance: memory-only material facts and evidence decoration score zero
a semantic evaluator cannot override an exact failure
score replay is byte-deterministic and order-invariant for unordered evidence
todos.example: A claim with strong authority but no observed lineage remains zero rather than averaging to a moderate score.
todos.rollback: remove scorer from the public assessment surface

todos.action: Aggregate claims using a materiality- and decision-risk-weighted harmonic mean, frozen coverage multiplier, critical-claim floor, and answer-level gates.
acceptance: one unsupported headline conclusion cannot be averaged away by many grounded minor facts
claim-local failures do not alter unrelated claims
critical score below 70 prevents the high-control band
todos.example: Ten grounded background facts cannot hide an unsupported treatment recommendation.
todos.rollback: emit claim assessments without an answer aggregate

todos.action: Compute lower and upper score bounds for unassessed dimensions and define not_calculable, insufficient_evidence, assessed, and blocked states.
acceptance: planned-only input returns not_calculable
interval width above 20 or incomplete claim coverage returns insufficient_evidence
the display never presents a crisp score whose inputs are materially unknown
todos.example: An inaccessible source behind a redaction produces a visible score range rather than inferred verification.
todos.rollback: return only per-claim unknown states

todos.action: Emit grounded coverage, memory-only rate, unsupported generative addition rate, citation-lineage mismatch rate, preservation failure rate, observed-versus-planned lineage coverage, evidence composition, weakest claims, and repair actions.
acceptance: every cap and gate points to exact claims, answer components, and evidence or missing receipts
adding verbosity or irrelevant citations cannot improve diagnostics or score
repairs state the minimum evidence or control needed for reassessment
todos.example: The assessment reports that two of eight material claims use post-hoc citations with no observed derivation path.
todos.rollback: retain machine-readable findings without a summary

todos.action: Invalidate selectively when the answer, material-claim inventory, source/version, evidence content, transformation, model/provider, envelope, verifier, provenance reconciliation, quality assessment, or policy changes.
acceptance: stale assessments cannot be attached to a changed answer
unaffected claims retain valid receipts
invalidation reasons and re-entry owners are explicit
todos.example: Changing one cited table invalidates dependent claims without discarding an unrelated deterministic calculation.
todos.rollback: require full reassessment rather than selective reuse

todos.action: Define a concise final trust card with status, interval, band, coverage, critical weaknesses, gates, evidence composition, policy version, and concrete remediation.
acceptance: the card distinguishes fact, derivation, hypothesis, unknown, and recommendation
it communicates methodological rigor without hidden chain-of-thought
the full claim ledger remains available as a linked machine-readable artifact
todos.example: The card explains that the answer is guarded because one critical full-text extraction lacks exact span verification.
todos.rollback: suppress the optional card while retaining the assessment artifact

todos.action: Add an opt-in assessment seam after observed component provenance reconciliation and quality assessment but before final delivery authorization.
acceptance: realized trust is never calculated inside route-only plan_stages or run_planner_request
the trust result cannot override existing must-pass gates or authorize execution
legacy final-delivery signatures and default behavior remain unchanged
todos.example: The assessment may hold a masked critical claim after execution, but it cannot convert a failed quality authorization into a pass.
todos.rollback: disable the opt-in post-execution seam

todos.action: Test schema strictness, arithmetic, boundedness, digest replay, ordering invariance, duplicate-source invariance, denominator freeze, monotonicity, critical floors, and selective invalidation.
acceptance: adding irrelevant or duplicate evidence never increases trust
removing a valid provenance edge never increases trust
adding valid independent evidence does not reduce trust unless it exposes a retained contradiction
identical receipts and policy replay byte-identically
todos.example: Permuting evidence atoms changes neither claim scores nor the canonical assessment digest.
todos.rollback: no promotion beyond fixture mode

todos.action: Create an answer-trust generative-masking benchmark with disclosed development cases and sealed validation cases.
acceptance: cases cover model-memory facts, post-hoc citation laundering, source swap, generated numbers, synthetic data as raw data, qualifier and negation loss, missingness masking, abstract/full-text confusion, mirrored sources, hidden contradictions, self-review, evidence cycles, prompt injection, and one weak critical claim among strong minor claims
each case provides exact oracle gates, caps, score ordering, and expected diagnostics
biomedical fixtures include plasma multiomics, literature synthesis, deterministic derivation, and clinical-claim boundaries
todos.example: A real trial citation with the wrong endpoint must score below the same claim with an exact table locator and verified endpoint.
todos.rollback: benchmark remains non-authoritative

todos.action: Create benign controls for user constraints, prospective methods, explicit unknowns, deterministic calculations, legitimate imputation, bounded hypotheses, narrow cohorts, preprints, and visible disagreement.
acceptance: properly typed non-factual content is not counted as an unsupported factual claim
legitimate derived data remains derived and can receive proportionate credit
single-source or exploratory evidence receives caveats rather than automatic blocking
todos.example: A declared multiple-imputation sensitivity analysis is not confused with an invented observed value.
todos.rollback: block threshold calibration until benign controls exist

todos.action: Prove planned-versus-observed polarity and disabled-mode non-interference across planner routes, continuation, quality, provenance, standalone distribution, skills, hooks, workflows, and Prism artifacts.
acceptance: planned-only cases never emit a realized score
default-disabled planner outputs and digests are unchanged
no test requires modifying a scientific skill, hook, workflow, or Prism file
wheel and source distribution package the schemas and policy consistently
todos.example: Running an existing planner golden fixture with trust disabled is byte-identical to its baseline.
todos.rollback: remove profile registration and packaged resources

todos.action: Calibrate weights, caps, intervals, and bands against blinded biomedical expert review on a frozen corpus while retaining deterministic gate oracles.
acceptance: report unsupported-escape recall, fabricated-value detection, citation-lineage mismatch detection, false-block rate, interval coverage, band confusion matrices, and inter-reviewer disagreement
weights are not tuned on release candidates
deterministic and semantic performance are reported separately
todos.example: Expert disagreement widens confidence or triggers review; it is not silently averaged into false certainty.
todos.rollback: retain the previous policy version and shadow-only status

todos.action: Roll out through off, fixture, shadow, audit, advisory, and policy-selected enforcement states with a pinned rollback switch.
acceptance: fixture and shadow states have no delivery or user-visible authority
advisory state exposes trust cards without blocking
enforcement is limited to policy-selected high-impact gates after published thresholds pass
rollback leaves existing behavior and stored artifacts readable
todos.example: Citation-lineage mismatch can be observed in shadow telemetry before it is allowed to hold delivery.
todos.rollback: return immediately to off while preserving assessment artifacts for audit

todos.action: Define promotion and stop criteria for each rollout state, including escape rates, false blocks, reproducibility, latency, artifact size, compatibility, and human-review capacity.
acceptance: fabricated exact values and citation-lineage mismatches are detected in all disclosed fixtures before advisory promotion
high-control status requires all critical gates and critical claim scores at or above 70
any planned-as-observed regression, score nondeterminism, or legacy incompatibility triggers rollback
todos.example: A lower aggregate disagreement rate cannot compensate for one reproducible planned-as-observed escape.
todos.rollback: freeze promotion and pin the last passing state and policy

todos.action: Document lifecycle placement, artifacts, provenance joins, policy interpretation, user trust cards, operator diagnostics, calibration limits, and reassessment procedures.
acceptance: documentation states which outputs are prospective and realized
operators can trace every displayed number to claim inputs and policy
users receive methodological explanation without chain-of-thought or unsupported assurance
todos.example: A user can follow a guarded score to the exact unverified claim, missing receipt, applicable cap, and repair.
todos.rollback: remove links to disabled surfaces while retaining design history
